summary: Iter 67 frontend feature test PASSED (5/5 scenarios). Gantt chart now correctly renders an AMS Contract row (purple, #8B5CF6) for AMS_Shared / AMS_Dedicated / AMS_Mix waves. Verified via 3 fresh projects created through /api/projects + one pre-existing impl-only regression project. Acceptance criteria (row testid, range labels, bar CSS position, purple border color, legend chip, no-regression on non-AMS projects) all satisfied.
critical_code_review_comments: GanttCard.buildGanttRows: AMS branch is clean and additive — computes absStart=offset, absEnd=offset+contractMonths, startLabel/endLabel exposed as `wave_start_month` and `wave_start_month+contractMonths-1`. Bar CSS positions match the formula exactly for maxMonth=17 (S1), maxMonth=7 (S2 Mix), maxMonth=3 (S3).

AMS_COLOR border #8B5CF6 correctly rendered as rgb(139, 92, 246) — visually distinct from existing phase colors (no overlap with Prepare/Explore/Realize/Deploy/Go-live/Hypercare/Design/Build/Test/UAT/Support/PGLS).
AMS row participates in maxMonth calculation so the timeline auto-extends when AMS contract runs past all phase_ranges (verified: S1 maxMonth=17 driven by AMS end).
AMS_Mix correctly shows BOTH the AMS Contract row and the T&M phase rows (S2 produced 2 rows: AMS Contract (6mo) + Build).

Excel export path (`exportGanttExcel`) uses row.color.bg / row.color.border which are set from AMS_COLOR for AMS rows, so downstream Excel export will inherit purple styling automatically — no code change needed (not visually verified with actual file download in this run).
Minor cosmetic: AMS row shows range label as `<startLabel>–<endLabel>` (e.g. `6–17`) next to the phase name — consistent with existing phase-range labels. Good.
